analytics_events_device.name: analytics_events_device
analytics_events_device.value: device IS NULL OR device IN ('mobile', 'desktop')

business_invitations_target.name: business_invitations_target
business_invitations_target.value: target IN ('email', 'link', 'user') AND (target = 'email') = (email_lower IS NOT NULL) AND (target = 'user') = (invited_profile_id IS NOT NULL)

business_invitations_role.name: business_invitations_role
business_invitations_role.value: (kind = 'staff' AND manager_role IS NULL AND location_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind = 'manager' AND manager_role IN ('owner', 'location_manager') AND (manager_role = 'owner') = (location_id IS NULL))

business_invitations_outcome.name: business_invitations_outcome
business_invitations_outcome.value: (accepted_at IS NOT NULL)::int + (declined_at IS NOT NULL)::int + (revoked_at IS NOT NULL)::int <= 1 AND (accepted_at IS NULL) = (accepted_by IS NULL)

business_locations_text.name: business_locations_text
business_locations_text.value: char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND char_length(address) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

business_members_left.name: business_members_left
business_members_left.value: (left_at IS NULL) = (left_by IS NULL) AND (left_by IS NULL OR left_by IN ('self', 'manager', 'tipme', 'account_deleted'))

business_note_flags_review.name: business_note_flags_review
business_note_flags_review.value: (reviewed_at IS NULL) = (outcome IS NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('restored', 'removed'))

business_notes_body.name: business_notes_body
business_notes_body.value: body IS NULL OR char_length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 280

business_notes_something.name: business_notes_something
business_notes_something.value: cardinality(tags) > 0 OR body IS NOT NULL

business_shifts_ended.name: business_shifts_ended
business_shifts_ended.value: (ended_at IS NULL) = (ended_by IS NULL) AND (ended_by IS NULL OR ended_by IN ('self', 'manager', 'expired', 'left'))

businesses_contact.name: businesses_contact
businesses_contact.value: char_length(contact_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND char_length(contact_email) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND (contact_phone IS NULL OR char_length(contact_phone) <= 32)

businesses_suspended.name: businesses_suspended
businesses_suspended.value: (status = 'suspended') = (suspended_at IS NOT NULL) AND (suspended_at IS NULL OR suspended_reason IS NOT NULL)

businesses_verified.name: businesses_verified
businesses_verified.value: status = 'pending' OR verified_at IS NOT NULL

changelog_entries_published_together.name: changelog_entries_published_together
changelog_entries_published_together.value:
("changelog_entries"."published_audience" IS NULL AND "changelog_entries"."published_revision" IS NULL AND "changelog_entries"."published_text" IS NULL)
        OR ("changelog_entries"."published_audience" IS NOT NULL AND "changelog_entries"."published_revision" IS NOT NULL
            AND ("changelog_entries"."published_audience" = 'staff') = ("changelog_entries"."published_text" IS NULL))

changelog_entries_withdrawn_together.name: changelog_entries_withdrawn_together
changelog_entries_withdrawn_together.value:
("changelog_entries"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL AND "changelog_entries"."withdrawn_by" IS NULL AND "changelog_entries"."withdrawn_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("changelog_entries"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL AND "changelog_entries"."withdrawn_by" IS NOT NULL
            AND "changelog_entries"."withdrawn_reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("changelog_entries"."withdrawn_reason") > 0)

email_recoveries_due.name: email_recoveries_due
email_recoveries_due.where: completed_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL

handle_reservations_released.name: handle_reservations_released
handle_reservations_released.value: "handle_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL OR ("handle_reservations"."released_by" IS NOT NULL AND "handle_reservations"."release_reason" IS NOT NULL)

handle_take_backs_notice_days.name: handle_take_backs_notice_days
handle_take_backs_notice_days.value: ("handle_take_backs"."category" = 'ordinary' AND "handle_take_backs"."notice_days" BETWEEN 7 AND 30) OR ("handle_take_backs"."category" <> 'ordinary' AND "handle_take_backs"."notice_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 7)

issues_resolution_outcome.name: issues_resolution_outcome
issues_resolution_outcome.value: resolution_outcome IS NULL OR (status = 'resolved' AND resolution_outcome IN ('resolved_by_provider', 'recipient_owes', 'written_off', 'staff_confirmed_absent', 'account_secured'))

issues_resolution.name: issues_resolution
issues_resolution.value: (status = 'open') = (resolved_at IS NULL AND resolved_by IS NULL)

ledger_accounts_one_owner.name: ledger_accounts_one_owner
ledger_accounts_one_owner.value: profile_id IS NULL OR business_id IS NULL

message_flags_reason.name: message_flags_reason
message_flags_reason.value: report_reason IS NULL OR report_reason IN ('abusive', 'spam', 'other')

payment_reserve_readings_known.name: payment_reserve_readings_known
payment_reserve_readings_known.value:
(available_minor IS NULL AND low IS NULL)
        OR (available_minor IS NOT NULL AND low IS NOT NULL AND low = (available_minor < threshold_minor))

payout_destinations_business_active.name: payout_destinations_business_active
payout_destinations_business_active.where: replaced_at IS NULL AND business_id IS NOT NULL

payouts_start_step.name: payouts_start_step
payouts_start_step.value: start_step IS NULL OR start_step IN ('fee', 'payout')

profiles_custom_fee_bps.name: profiles_custom_fee_bps
profiles_custom_fee_bps.value: custom_fee_bps IS NULL OR custom_fee_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

profiles_min_tip.name: profiles_min_tip
profiles_min_tip.value: min_tip_minor IS NULL OR (min_tip_minor >= 100000 AND min_tip_minor % 100 = 0)

profiles_tip_presets.name: profiles_tip_presets
profiles_tip_presets.value: tip_presets_minor IS NULL OR cardinality(tip_presets_minor) BETWEEN 1 AND 4

profiles_tip_presets_range.name: profiles_tip_presets_range
profiles_tip_presets_range.value: tip_presets_minor IS NULL OR min_tip_minor <= ALL (tip_presets_minor)

profiles_tip_start_in_presets.name: profiles_tip_start_in_presets
profiles_tip_start_in_presets.value: tip_start_minor IS NULL OR coalesce(tip_start_minor = ANY (tip_presets_minor), false)

profiles_thanks_line_length.name: profiles_thanks_line_length
profiles_thanks_line_length.value: thanks_line IS NULL OR char_length(thanks_line) BETWEEN 1 AND 140

profiles_thanks_style.name: profiles_thanks_style
profiles_thanks_style.value: thanks_style IS NULL OR thanks_style IN ('paper', 'violet', 'night')

share_agreements_latest_accepted.name: share_agreements_latest_accepted
share_agreements_latest_accepted.where: accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND ended_at IS NULL AND superseded_by IS NULL

share_agreements_open.name: share_agreements_open
share_agreements_open.where: accepted_at IS NULL AND declined_at IS NULL AND withdrawn_at IS NULL

share_agreements_answer.name: share_agreements_answer
share_agreements_answer.value: (accepted_at IS NOT NULL)::int + (declined_at IS NOT NULL)::int + (withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL)::int <= 1

share_agreements_ended.name: share_agreements_ended
share_agreements_ended.value: (ended_at IS NULL AND superseded_by IS NULL) OR accepted_at IS NOT NULL

share_reports_body.name: share_reports_body
share_reports_body.value: body IS NULL OR char_length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 280

tip_quotes_amounts.name: tip_quotes_amounts
tip_quotes_amounts.value: tip_minor > 0 AND platform_fee_minor >= 0 AND provider_fee_minor >= 0 AND recipient_net_minor > 0

tips_team_no_member.name: tips_team_no_member
tips_team_no_member.value: team_location_id IS NULL OR business_member_id IS NULL

tips_purpose_known.name: tips_purpose_known
tips_purpose_known.value: purpose IS NULL OR purpose IN ('thank_you', 'great_service', 'helped_me', 'celebration', 'gift', 'other')

users_verified_email.name: users_verified_email
users_verified_email.where: email_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

users_verified_recovery_email.name: users_verified_recovery_email
users_verified_recovery_email.where: recovery_email_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

withdrawal_holds_release.name: withdrawal_holds_release
withdrawal_holds_release.value: released_by IS NULL OR released_at IS NOT NULL
